const originalValues = Array.prototype.values;
function collect(...values: number[]) {
  console.log([...arguments]);
}
function bump(first: number, second: number) {
  first++;
  console.log([...arguments]);
}
collect(0);
Array.prototype.values = function () {
  return originalValues.call([9]);
};
console.log(Array.prototype.values.call([3]).next().value);
collect(1, 2);
Object.defineProperty(Array.prototype, 'values', {
  configurable: true,
  get() {
    console.log('values getter');
    return undefined;
  },
});
bump(4, 5);
delete (Array.prototype as { values?: typeof originalValues }).values;
collect(6, 7);
